technicalDecisions.recommendation: Fact create/update/delete take pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared on the existing per-user merge key (ADVISORY_LOCK_CLASS.characterMerge, 'char-merge:<userId>') as the first statement of their transaction, then validate scope and write.
